name: Unilateral Deposit Forfeiture
reason: Unilateral total forfeiture of security deposit without genuine pre-estimate of damages acts as an unlawful penalty clause.
legalSource: Indian Contract Act, 1872 - Section 74 (Penalty stipulations unenforceable without proof of actual damages)
caveat: Landlord can deduct actual proven rent arrears or physical damages, but blanket forfeiture is legally challengeable.

name: Arbitrary Landlord Entry Without Prior Notice
pattern: enter.*(any time|without notice|at will|without prior permission)
reason: Clause grants unfettered right of entry, violating tenant quiet enjoyment and statutory privacy safeguards.
legalSource: Model Tenancy Act, 2021 - Section 15 (Minimum 24 hours prior written/electronic notice required before entry)
caveat: Emergency entry during structural peril or flood is permitted, but routine inspections require statutory prior notice.

name: One-Sided Notice Period
reason: Unequal termination notice creates severe asymmetry favoring the landlord.
caveat: Ensure notice periods are strictly mutual (typically 1 month for standard residential tenancies).

name: Standard Mutual 30-Day Notice
reason: Standard reciprocal exit clause protecting both tenant and owner fairly.
legalSource: Model Tenancy Act, 2021 & Transfer of Property Act, 1882
caveat: Standard statutory practice across all Indian states.
